collection.title: Audi RS4 Avant 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi RS4 Avant 2017 onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and passengers side and a 20" wiper blade with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this model too.
